name: Tavel

limits: Grenache, Grenache Blanc and Grenache Gris together: 30 to 60%

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

notes: It is dry, with more body and structure than most rosés.
Longer skin contact for part of the juice makes it more powerful, more tannic and darker than other rosés.

blurb.text: A southern Rhône appellation that makes only rosé, across the river from Châteauneuf-du-Pape, in the commune of Tavel and part of Roquemaure. Allowed grapes include Grenache, Cinsault, Syrah, Mourvèdre and Clairette.
